- If gumipar and dimasen are the nexioms, this test acts like gumipar alone, so the machine lights.
- If the other possibility is true, it acts like lemulen alone, so the machine stays dark.

The last test lit up, which settles it.

- **Lemulen paired with one of sozivon, pegabo or kovezol is ruled out.** That pair predicted gumipar with lemulen would stay dark, but it lit.
